section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 2000 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.8.5 Nearly (36.5%) of ‘Railway Accidents’ (other than ‘Rail-Road) accident’ were reported in Maharashtra State only, followed by West Bengal (12.3%). Among UTs, Delhi recorded 763 (out of 771)) such accidents during the year, all of which were reported from Delhi City.
